return.taxCreditNote: The tax credit comes from FTA forms 1050, 1055 and 1056. TILL does not calculate it and therefore shows no amount: a nil here would be a figure nobody checked.
return.saldoPayableNote: Line 500 is calculated without the tax credit. If you claim one, the amount you actually pay is lower.

return.exportNote: Step 3: TILL produces the eCH-0217 file (version 2.0.0) and you download it. In step 4 you upload it to the FTA ePortal yourself: there is no interface to the FTA.

title.uid: The VAT number is missing or unusable
title.rateSplit: More than one tax rate on one form line
title.byHand: This period cannot be expressed as a file

title.failed: The file could not be built

export.uid: Every eCH-0217 declaration names the company UID. The company profile carries none, or none in the format CHE-###.###.###, so the file cannot be built.
export.rateSplit: Line {ziffern} carries turnover at more than one tax rate. The file names exactly one rate per row, and a rate this turnover did not bear would be a wrong declaration. Check the tax codes on the entries behind it, split them, then export again.

byHand.unmapped: The return carries line {ziffern}, which eCH-0217 v2.0.0 has no element for. The file would be short by that amount, and the form would not show you.
byHand.saldoRates: This workspace has {count} net tax rates configured. The FTA form carries two rows for them (lines 323 and 333) and no third.
byHand.currency: This workspace keeps its books in {currency}. A VAT return is filed in Swiss francs (MWSTV Art. 45), and eCH-0217 has no element for a currency.
byHand.remedy: You file this period in the ePortal by hand. The figures for it are on this page.

export.recompute: Building the file recalculates the return, and the calculation refused. Usually the VAT setup has changed since. Reload the return: the reason is then stated on this page.
export.failed: Nothing was changed and no file was written.
export.crossCheckTitle: The FTA will calculate a different tax
export.crossCheck: Per rate the file carries only the rate and the turnover, no tax amount. From those the FTA calculates {recomputed}. Your entries come to {booked}, a difference of {difference}.
export.crossCheckCause: This usually comes from foreign-currency documents, which are rounded once per document. The file is valid, and you know the difference here rather than at the FTA.

journey.label: How filing works
journey.4: filed in the ePortal (you, outside TILL)

recon.notApplicable: The net tax rate method cannot be checked against account 2200, because the VAT invoiced and the VAT owed are different figures (Art. 37 MWSTG).
recon.noAccount: The VAT account is missing from the chart of accounts, so the return cannot be checked against the books.
recon.matchNote: The tax due equals the movement on the VAT account.
recon.noCauses: TILL does not attribute the difference to a cause yet, so all of it sits under unexplained. It is often a VAT payment to the FTA for an earlier period, or an entry posted straight to the VAT account with no tax code.
recon.investigate: Check the entries on the VAT accounts

return.filedRecomputed: No further entries can be added. The figures below are recalculated and are not a stored copy.
return.filedCorrection: Corrections go through the annual reconciliation under Art. 72 MWSTG, which TILL does not produce yet.
return.confirmBody: TILL records that you filed this return and locks the period. Nothing is transmitted to the FTA: you upload the file in the ePortal yourself.
return.confirmIrreversible: The lock cannot be undone here. Unlocking is only possible under Periods.
return.confirmAck: I have checked the unexplained difference of {amount}.
return.needsConfig: VAT is not set up for this workspace yet, so there is no return to calculate.
return.saldoSplitRequired: This workspace has {count} net tax rates. Each rate belongs to one business activity, and the VAT Ordinance requires you to book the revenue for each rate separately (MWSTV Art. 84 Abs. 3). No entry in TILL says which activity it belongs to, so TILL cannot apportion the turnover and cannot calculate the return.
return.saldoRateNotValid: The configured net tax rate of {rate} percent was not on the FTA list for this period. TILL stores only the current rate and not its history, so the rate approved at the time cannot be established from here.
return.istNotImplemented: TILL currently calculates returns on agreed consideration (accrual) only. Filing on collected consideration (cash basis) counts a supply in the period it was paid; for a workspace set to it, TILL gives you no figures rather than wrong ones.

refusal.deniedTitle: No access to the VAT return

VatReturn.title: VAT return
VatReturn.body: TILL computes the return from your posted records and shows every position with its Ziffer of the ESTV form, so you can map the figures in the ePortal directly. Filing happens outside TILL; afterwards you mark the period as filed here and it locks. Corrections run through a correction return, never by rewriting a locked period.
